staticFrame.alt: Decorative dark wooden loom with empty film rails, used as a non-evidentiary frame behind the real Vivid sequence.

scenes.label: 01 / Written scene
scenes.heading: A scene needs beats before it needs frames.
scenes.narration: Vivid begins by turning a written idea into a small ordered plan: world, person, action, and the next image that has to earn its place.

scenes.label: 02 / Character anchor
scenes.heading: The person is the master pattern.
scenes.narration: A neutral reference gives the sequence a person to keep, without making an earlier rendered pose the rule for every following shot.

scenes.label: 03 / Reference bindings
scenes.heading: The plan and anchor become the loom's threads.
scenes.narration: The visible threads stand for planned continuity bindings. They are decorative movement; the ordinary narration carries the real boundary.

scenes.label: 04 / Contact sheet
scenes.heading: Four frames make one question visible.
scenes.narration: These are real frames from the cleared Kyoto pottery evaluation sequence. Together they are more useful than one showcase image.

scenes.label: 05 / Rejected speedup
scenes.heading: Faster was not good enough to ship.
scenes.narration: The faster Turbo profile stayed rejected after visual review found quality regressions. The baseline remained the production choice.

scenes.label: 06 / Evidence boundary
scenes.heading: A missing visual stays missing.
scenes.narration: The documented pose-copying finding is not reenacted here because the publishable before-and-after comparison is unavailable.

scenes.label: 07 / Current boundary
scenes.heading: A promising sequence is not a solved product.
scenes.narration: The sequence is portfolio-cleared evidence. Commercial product-model licensing remains unresolved, and no claimed capability goes beyond the audited record.

scenes.label: 08 / Deep-dive handoff
scenes.heading: The loom stops. The case study keeps the record.
scenes.narration: The paper case study carries the architecture, measured baseline, rejected Turbo result, failures, research and future work.

audio.explanation: This visual evaluation world has no audio asset or audio interaction.
